mapper.sql: status_id AS statusId, name, description, status_kind AS statusKind, status_type_id AS statusTypeId, control_profile_id AS controlProfileId, stack_group_key AS stackGroupKey, source_scope AS sourceScope, stack_mode AS stackMode, max_stacks AS maxStacks, max_instances AS maxInstances, duration_mode AS durationMode, duration_ms AS durationMs, duration_formula_id AS durationFormulaId, default_magnitude_formula_id AS defaultMagnitudeFormulaId, snapshot_policy AS snapshotPolicy, is_dispellable AS isDispellable, cleanse_priority AS cleansePriority, extend::text AS extendJson
mapper.select: SELECT FROM public.status_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY status_id
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.status_definitions (game_id, status_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, name, description, status_kind, status_type_id, control_profile_id, stack_group_key, source_scope, stack_mode, max_stacks, max_instances, duration_mode, duration_ms, duration_formula_id, default_magnitude_formula_id, snapshot_policy, is_dispellable, cleanse_priority, extend, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{statusId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{statusKind}, #{statusTypeId}, #{controlProfileId}, #{stackGroupKey}, #{sourceScope}, #{stackMode}, #{maxStacks}, #{maxInstances}, #{durationMode}, #{durationMs}, #{durationFormulaId}, #{defaultMagnitudeFormulaId}, #{snapshotPolicy}, #{dispellable}, #{cleansePriority}, COALESCE(CAST(#{extendJson} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, status_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, status_kind = EXCLUDED.status_kind, status_type_id = EXCLUDED.status_type_id, control_profile_id = EXCLUDED.control_profile_id, stack_group_key = EXCLUDED.stack_group_key, source_scope = EXCLUDED.source_scope, stack_mode = EXCLUDED.stack_mode, max_stacks = EXCLUDED.max_stacks, max_instances = EXCLUDED.max_instances, duration_mode = EXCLUDED.duration_mode, duration_ms = EXCLUDED.duration_ms, duration_formula_id = EXCLUDED.duration_formula_id, default_magnitude_formula_id = EXCLUDED.default_magnitude_formula_id, snapshot_policy = EXCLUDED.snapshot_policy, is_dispellable = EXCLUDED.is_dispellable, cleanse_priority = EXCLUDED.cleanse_priority, extend = EXCLUDED.extend, updated_at = NOW()
